question: 哪个地区的销量最高
gold_sql: select r.region_name, sum(oi.quantity) from order_items oi join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id join users u on o.user_id = u.user_id join regions r on u.region_id = r.region_id where o.status = '已完成' group by r.region_name order by sum(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT r.region_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.user_id
JOIN regions r ON u.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE o.status = '已完成'
GROUP BY r.region_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
